char_1012_skadi2.name: Skadi the Corrupting Heart
char_1012_skadi2.reason: S1 DamageSplit ON_TAKE_DAMAGE uses BUFF_SOURCE/NORMAL followed by nonstack one-minus DamageScale at LOWER_PRIORITY. Native recipient mitigation, recursive transfer suppression and modifier-event ordering are not recovered. Seaborn also requires source finish-recharge, skill-mode synchronization and host-ATK aura ownership; no generic token or shield fallback is enabled.
sourceContracts: S1 maxHP modifier plus HealViaMaxHpRatio startup; independent source protect aura and token trigger controller.
Seaborn category2, occupied slots0, any deployable tile, no facing picker; selected15/25-second lifetime, ON_OWNER_FINISH charge_token[finish], host removal die_to_kill_token.
S2 final ATK/DEF Inspire one-second immediate aura and token counterpart; S3 one-second delayed PURE damage per self/token region with separate final ATK Inspire and own HP loss.
Talent2 abyssal source group produces higher ATK bucket than ordinary allies.

char_4134_cetsyr.name: Civilight Eterna
char_4134_cetsyr.reason: The mandatory native orbital emitter mutates next_projectile_key, cnt, final_radius/default_radius and dynamic_spd across modes; cooldown collision controllers and orbit movement need a dedicated source-backed controller. Orbit phase, mutable projectile replacement/expiry and attachment order are not recovered. No global heal or periodic damage approximation is enabled.
sourceContracts: Default/S1/S3 particles orbit source with original150-degree rate; S2 selected dynamic_spd changes while radius transitions1.15→2. Serialized cooldown8589934592 is retained raw rather than guessed.
Source own-mark filters distinguish each producer; talent recipients have professionMask639 and ignoreHealFree1, retaining non-HEAL eligibility.

S3 HP redistribution explicitly records and sums recipient current/max HP, computes weighted total HP ratio, applies ratio with skipModifierEvent1 and resets collector blackboards. Its separate collection/calculation clock and source predicate/order still require implementation review.
S2 ON_OUTPUT_DAMAGE creates Bind; S1 modifies emitter cooldown and selected extra count; source particle lifetimes and stopWhenSourceInvalid are preserved.
